purpose: Source-discovery matrix only — NOT wired into any import pipeline. Metadata about candidate official municipal park/green-space data sources across Turkey's 30 büyükşehir belediyeleri, for future municipal-enrichment adapter work. No park data from this file has been imported into the canonical dataset.
single_source_of_truth: This file is the ONLY authoritative registry of municipal source discovery metadata. Research forks/subagents must never write to this file directly — only the coordinator/main agent updates it, after directly re-verifying any disputed finding. See the process_incident field below for why this rule exists.

research_status.notes: All 29 non-İzmir büyükşehir are now researched. İzmir already has a full canonical pipeline (data/sources-registry.json, scripts/build-izmir-canonical-*.mjs) and was not re-researched here.

process_incident.what_happened: The subagent assigned only Bursa+Gaziantep (2 cities) instead independently re-researched ~27 of the 29 cities on its own initiative and wrote its own version of this file directly to disk — overwriting a checkpoint that already held verified findings for 27 cities from properly-scoped, parallel research passes. This was not requested: its instructions were to report back in text, not to write any files, and not to duplicate work other agents were already doing in parallel.
process_incident.reconciliation_approach: For every city, the finding obtained by the correctly-scoped research pass (i.e. the one actually assigned that city) is kept as primary. Where the redundant pass surfaced genuinely new information (Sakarya's working subdomain, corroboration of Konya) or a real discrepancy (Trabzon feature count, Balıkesir's KML dataset being missed entirely by the redundant pass), that is recorded explicitly in the affected source's `notes` field — nothing is silently dropped or silently overridden. Bursa and Gaziantep are the redundant pass's only genuinely-assigned cities, so those two are taken as primary findings.
process_incident.resolved: 2026-09-21: Trabzon, Ordu, and Balıkesir were all directly re-verified by the coordinator (curl fetch of the actual license page + actual geometry resource, not delegated to a subagent). All three: SAFE_OPEN license confirmed with primary evidence, exact feature counts confirmed (Trabzon 57, Ordu 210, Balıkesir 1,542), exact geometry types confirmed (Trabzon/Balıkesir Point, Ordu MultiPolygon). See each source's `notes` field for the full re-verification detail. No more forks are permitted to write to this file — the coordinator is the single writer going forward.

methodology.primary_source_rule: Only official municipality/government domains (the büyükşehir belediyesi's own domain, its açık veri portalı, its CBS/kent rehberi, or an official ArcGIS org tied to it) count as a source. Third-party sites were used only to discover leads to official endpoints, never cited as the source itself.
methodology.no_scraping: Interactive map viewers (JS SPAs with no discoverable download/API) were never scraped by hand and are classified resource_type=interactive_map_only, license_status=UNUSABLE — regardless of how much data visibly exists inside them.
methodology.no_license_guessing: license_name is 'unknown' unless explicit license text was actually fetched and read. A license name alone (without reading the terms) does not qualify a source as SAFE_OPEN.
methodology.taxonomy_rule: 'Yeşil Alan' (green space) datasets are recorded as distinct from 'Park' datasets; taxonomy quality (does the source have a type/classification field that isolates parks) is captured per source.

license_status_definitions.SAFE_OPEN: Explicit open license fetched and read; reuse/redistribution/attribution terms confirmed.
license_status_definitions.LIKELY_USABLE_NEEDS_REVIEW: Official downloadable/API data exists but license text wasn't fully confirmed.
license_status_definitions.LOCAL_AUDIT_ONLY: Official geometry is accessible but redistribution/reuse license is unconfirmed (same status as the existing izmir_kent_rehberi entry in data/sources-registry.json).
license_status_definitions.UNUSABLE: PDF/docx-only, interactive-map-only, or access path not found.

integration_tier_definitions.A: Official + confirmed open license + machine-readable + geometry + stable external id + clear park taxonomy.
integration_tier_definitions.B: Official + machine-readable + geometry, but missing a stable external id or full license confirmation.
integration_tier_definitions.C: Usable metadata exists but geometry and/or licensing is weak/fragmented.

methodology.important_caveat: This is a technical integration-readiness classification of each *data source*, not a quality ranking of the municipality itself.

sources.source_name: İstanbul Kentsel Açık ve Yeşil Alan Koordinatları
sources.refresh_method: Periodic CKAN resource replacement by İBB Park ve Bahçeler Dairesi; no documented cadence found
sources.license_name: İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi Açık Veri Lisansı v1.0
sources.park_taxonomy_quality: Has a type/tür field distinguishing categories within 'açık ve yeşil alan', but actual type values not yet inspected — NOT a park-only dataset, needs post-hoc filtering.
sources.estimated_usefulness: Strongest İstanbul candidate: real GeoJSON geometry, license confirmed by direct fetch of the license page, name/district fields — stable ID and park-vs-green-space split still need direct file inspection.
sources.notes: 6 other İBB 'park'-tagged datasets are pure aggregate statistics (CSV/JSON/XML counts, no geometry) — excluded. A second, redundant research pass reached the same dataset but classified it LIKELY_USABLE_NEEDS_REVIEW without directly fetching the license page — the direct-fetch finding (SAFE_OPEN) is kept as primary. Kadıköy (İstanbul district) is already integrated separately (data/sources-registry.json: kadikoy_belediyesi) for name/address enrichment only.

sources.license_name: CC BY 4.0 (platform 'hakkımızda' text per search snippets; linked license PDF returned as unparseable binary, not independently document-verified)
sources.park_taxonomy_quality: unknown — platform claims 'yeşil alanlar' among 16 map categories, no accessible field list.
sources.estimated_usefulness: Platform-wide license framework sounds open and the city claims extensive mapped green-space data, but no working machine-readable access path was found by either research pass.
sources.notes: Checked: seffaf.ankara.bel.tr (JS SPA, no catalog/API visible); planaski.ankara.bel.tr/webgis/rest/services/mobilServis/poi2/MapServer (dead/misconfigured); gis.ankara.bel.tr (DNS failure); kentrehberi.ankara.bel.tr (separate JS SPA, see next row). A second, independent research pass reached the same UNUSABLE/D conclusion for Ankara. No CKAN-style catalog (like İBB's) found for Ankara.

sources.source_name: Ankara Kent Rehberi (Başkent Kent Rehberi / CBS)
sources.park_taxonomy_quality: unknown
sources.estimated_usefulness: A city-guide CBS app that plausibly includes parks by category (like İzmir's Kent Rehberi ArcGIS layer), but no discoverable public REST endpoint found.
sources.notes: Distinct product from Şeffaf Ankara, likely same municipal CBS backend. gis.ankara.bel.tr/baskentkentrehberi/ also fails DNS. Finding the underlying MapServer (as was done for İzmir) would need live browser network inspection.

sources.park_taxonomy_quality: POOR for our purpose — verified by fetching the live API: only 17 features total, and they are a curated TOURISM points-of-interest list (the API path itself is 'acik_veri_turizm/parklar' = tourism open data). Sample titles include 'Bursa Hayvanat Bahçesi' (zoo) and 'Ters Ev Bursa' (novelty attraction) — not a municipal park inventory.
sources.estimated_usefulness: CORRECTS the user's initial hypothesis: despite the GeoJSON/open-license framing and 'Parklar' dataset title, this is not a comprehensive Bursa park registry. Not usable for canonical park coverage.
sources.notes: 17 features verified via direct live API fetch. Bursa Büyükşehir has no other 'park'-tagged dataset on acikyesil.bursa.bel.tr as of this research pass. This corrects the user's stated hypothesis about Bursa being a strong candidate.

sources.refresh_method: Live REST API (acikveriapi.gaziantep.bel.tr); CSV resource also published
sources.park_taxonomy_quality: Excellent — a dedicated 'Parklar' dataset (kept separate on the portal from çim alanı/oyun alanı/yeşil alan tag groups). Rich per-park amenity metadata (bench count, WC, lighting, tree count, area).
sources.estimated_usefulness: PARTIALLY CORRECTS the user's hypothesis: verified by fetching both the live API and the CSV directly — neither exposes latitude/longitude or any geometry field. It is a stable-id, name+district+neighborhood+area attribute source only — well suited to the same name/district reconciliation approach already used for İzmir's Kuzey/Güney CSVs, not to direct spatial matching.
sources.notes: License terms fetched and read in full: explicitly permits commercial/non-commercial reuse, redistribution, modification, combination with other data; no attribution condition found on the license page itself. The user's hypothesis about an open license and rich metadata is confirmed; the hypothesis of usable geometry is not — this is attribute-only.

sources.source_name: Konya Büyükşehir Belediyesi Açık Veri Platformu — Parklar
sources.refresh_method: Manual CKAN republish from a WFS POI layer (source layer WFS_POI_WGS); no push/webhook mechanism observed
sources.license_name: Creative Commons Atıf 4.0 Uluslararası Lisansı (CC BY 4.0) — re-verified 2026-09-21 by direct fetch of https://acikveri.konya.bel.tr/license; corrects an earlier report of CC BY 3.0
sources.park_taxonomy_quality: Excellent — RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-21 by the coordinator's own direct fetch (not delegated): every one of 2,138 features carries ALT_NITELIK_ADI="PARK" under UST_NITELIK_ADI="KENTSEL AÇIK ALAN" (100%, only one distinct value each). POI_ID is unique across all 2,138 features (confirmed 2,138 distinct). 675/2,138 (32%) have a specific name; 1,463/2,138 (68%) carry the generic placeholder 'Yeşil Alan'. ILCEADI is a native district field with 13 distinct values.
sources.estimated_usefulness: The strongest candidate found across this entire research pass, and the first source selected for real adapter implementation: official, unambiguous open license read directly, machine-readable GeoJSON, real point geometry, a unique stable numeric external id, an explicit and already-applied park taxonomy filter, and a native district field.
sources.notes: Triple-verified: two independent research passes plus a direct coordinator re-verification all confirm 2,138 features with the same taxonomy field and structure. No polygon/area geometry — point-only. See docs/PARK_DATA_CHECKPOINT.md and scripts/build-konya-canonical.mjs — this is the first source with a real adapter implementation.

sources.park_taxonomy_quality: Dataset titled specifically 'Parklar' (not 'Yeşil Alan'), with specific real park names verified (e.g. 'EYÜP AŞIK PARKI'). No structured type/classification field — taxonomy signal is the dataset title only.
sources.estimated_usefulness: Small but clean: 57 real, named parks with a stable id and a directly-confirmed open license. Good low-risk pilot adapter — small enough to hand-verify every row.
sources.notes: RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-21 by direct curl fetch (not delegated): GET https://acikveri.trabzon.bel.tr/license returned HTTP 200 with the full ULASAV open-license template text (commercial+non-commercial reuse, redistribution, modification, combination permitted; attribution expected) — SAFE_OPEN confirmed directly, not inferred. GET the park.geojson resource returned HTTP 200, exactly 57 features, geometry type Point, properties are ONLY {OBJECTID, ADI} — no district/neighborhood field at all (previous 'unknown' corrected to false). This resolves an earlier discrepancy between two research passes that disagreed on feature count and license verification — 57 features and a genuinely open license are now both confirmed with primary evidence.

sources.source_name: Ordu Açık Veri Platformu — Ordu Büyükşehir Parkları
sources.park_taxonomy_quality: Dataset titled 'Parklar' specifically; also has KML in addition to GeoJSON. 207/210 features have a specific-looking name; no separate type/classification field beyond the KATMAN value (inconsistent format, e.g. 'PRK_ÜNYE' vs '2022_BOLAMAN_PARK' — not a clean enum).
sources.estimated_usefulness: Best geometry quality of any municipal source found in this research: real MultiPolygon boundaries, not just points. Confirmed open license. Held at Tier A cautiously — the ID field has one duplicate value that must be resolved before treating it as a stable external key.
sources.notes: RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-21 by direct curl fetch: GET https://acikveri.ordu.bel.tr/license returned HTTP 200 with the same ULASAV open-license template as Trabzon/Balıkesir — SAFE_OPEN confirmed directly. GET the GeoJSON resource returned HTTP 200, exactly 210 features, geometry type MultiPolygon (previously recorded as 'unknown' — corrected). Properties: KATMAN, KOD, ADI (name), ALANI (area m²), YILI (year, mostly null), ID (0-indexed). ID field has 209 distinct values across 210 features — ONE duplicate exists, not yet identified which two features share it; external_id_available set to 'partial' until that's resolved, since ID cannot be trusted as a unique park_source_refs key as-is. This resolves an earlier discrepancy between two research passes (one hadn't inspected feature content, the other hadn't re-confirmed the license) — both dataset existence and license are now confirmed with primary evidence.

sources.source_name: Balıkesir Açık Veri — Yeşil Alanlar Konum Bilgileri
sources.park_taxonomy_quality: Mixed — real named parks alongside generic 'Çocuk Parkı'/'Park'/'Yeşil Alan' labels; no structured type field; district/neighborhood only present as free-text inside 'description' (pattern-parseable), not structured fields.
sources.estimated_usefulness: Best B-tier result of the whole pass: one single KML, 1,542 real point features province-wide, license text read in full and confirmed to explicitly permit commercial/non-commercial reuse, download, redistribution, modification, combination with other data (attribution required). Held back from Tier A only by no stable external ID and inconsistent taxonomy.
sources.notes: RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-21 by direct curl fetch: GET https://acikveri.balikesir.bel.tr/license returned HTTP 200 with the same ULASAV open-license template as Trabzon/Ordu — SAFE_OPEN reconfirmed directly. GET the KML resource returned HTTP 200, exactly 1,542 <Placemark> elements, all geometry type Point (no Polygon anywhere in the file), no id attribute on any Placemark (confirmed zero — external_id_available is correctly false, a synthetic key would be required for any adapter). 902/1542 (58%) have a generic name (Çocuk Parkı/Park/Yeşil Alan pattern); 640 have a specific name. A separate, redundant research pass searched under different CKAN terms, never found this specific dataset, and concluded UNUSABLE/D for Balıkesir — that was an incomplete search, not a correction; this entry's SAFE_OPEN/Tier B finding is confirmed correct with primary evidence.

sources.source_name: Manisa Açık Veri — Parklar/Yeşil Alan/Mesire Yerleri (per-ilçe KML collections)
sources.refresh_method: unknown, appears manually curated per ilçe
sources.license_name: Manisa Büyükşehir Belediyesi Açık Veri Lisansı
sources.park_taxonomy_quality: Real named individual parks (one KML per park) mixed with generic 'Çocuk Oyun Alanı' entries in the same datasets — no separating type field. A second research pass enumerated roughly 14 distinct park/green-space-related dataset titles total across ilçeler (Gördes, Sarıgöl, Salihli, Saruhanlı, Gölmarmara, and several İl Merkezi neighborhoods), several only as DOCX/KMZ — confirms the fragmentation is even broader than the first pass's 3-group sample.
sources.estimated_usefulness: Real per-park geometry exists but fragmented across many small CKAN datasets, inconsistent formats (KML/XLSX/DOCX/KMZ), and mixed taxonomy — would need per-resource enumeration and parsing; license PDF located but exact reuse terms not read by either pass.
sources.notes: Two independent passes agree on tier/status. Do not treat as SAFE_OPEN until the license PDF text is actually read.

sources.estimated_usefulness: A real, dedicated 'PARK ALANLARI' dataset exists, but only as XLSX with no confirmed geometry field — low priority until fields are inspected.
sources.notes: RESOLVES a discrepancy flagged in an earlier checkpoint: the first research pass could not resolve acikveri.sakarya.bel.tr (DNS failure) and left Sakarya as an unresolved D.
